chunks: Ibrāhīm ibn Sufyān wrote to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام:
The muhrim washes his hand with ushnān in which there is idhkhir.
So he wrote: “I do not like it for you.”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim wash his hands with ushnaan containing idhkhir?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal question concerning a muhrim using a cleansing substance containing idhkhir. Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام replied with disapproval, indicating that such use is not preferred for one in ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2665 - Ibrahim ibn Sufyan wrote to Abu al-Hasan (as) asking about a Muhrim washing his hands with soapwort (ushnan) that contains idhkhar (a type of fragrant grass).
Imam (as) wrote back: "I do not like it for you."
